components.name: Primary Studio Button
components.description: The decisive action inside a context panel or order flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); border-radius:999px; background:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); padding:0 18px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:800 12px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease-out,color .2s ease-out,transform .2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); color:#fff; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Studio Button
components.description: A secondary action that stays quiet inside white panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #d5dce3; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; padding:0 18px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:800 12px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .2s ease-out,background .2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); background:rgb(8 185 212 / .08); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background:rgb(8 185 212 / .14); }

components.name: Studio Tool
components.description: Icon-and-label destination used in the navy rail; shown here in its active state.
components.css: .ds-studio-tool { display:flex; min-width:64px; min-height:62px; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:transparent; color:#fff; font:700 10px Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-studio-tool svg { width:20px; height:20px; } .ds-studio-tool:hover,.ds-studio-tool.active { background:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); } .ds-studio-tool:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-studio-tool:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Studio Field
components.description: Compact operational field used throughout product, text, and order panels.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display:grid; gap:7px; color:rgb(7 22 61 / .6); font:800 10px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #d5dce3; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; padding:10px 12px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:400 14px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:normal; outline:none; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:#aeb9c5; } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(8 185 212 / .14); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: A compact binary or segmented choice; shown selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:44px; border:1px solid #d5dce3; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; padding:0 13px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:700 12px Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease-out,color .2s ease-out,border-color .2s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); } .ds-chip.active { border-color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); background:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.css: .ds-product-card { width:250px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font-family:Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-product-media { position:relative; display:grid; aspect-ratio:4/4.55; place-items:center; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #d5dce3; border-radius:16px; background:#f7f8fa; } .ds-product-badge { position:absolute; z-index:1; top:12px; left:12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .94); padding:4px 10px; color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:700 11px/1 Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgb(17 24 39 / .08); } .ds-product-media svg { width:78%; transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-media svg { transform:scale(1.035); } .ds-product-card h3 { min-height:2.75rem; margin:16px 0 0; font:800 16px/1.35 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-product-card p { margin:4px 0 0; color:rgb(7 22 61 / .58); font:400 12px/20px Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-product-meta { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin-top:12px; font-size:12px; } .ds-product-meta span { color:rgb(7 22 61 / .58); } .ds-product-card button { width:100%; min-height:44px; margin-top:16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); color:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); font:800 12px Inter,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),color .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-product-card button:hover { background:var(--brand-navy, #07163d); color:#fff; } .ds-product-card button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brand-cyan, #08b9d4); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
FabPodd Customise is an orderly path from a wall of blank goods into a precise, full-screen making environment. The catalogue feels spacious and editorial enough to help shoppers choose; the designer becomes compact, persistent, and operational so the garment and printable result remain the visual centre.

The system is crisp rather than sterile: deep navy gives the workspace authority, cyan makes actions and state changes unmistakable, and cool near-whites leave room for product imagery. Rounded controls and diffuse shadows soften the tool without making it playful. Product, print boundary, side state, and price always outrank decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Product imagery is dominant and sits on quiet cool-grey stages.
Navy provides structure; cyan is reserved for action, focus, and selection.
Persistent desktop rails become compact mobile rails and bottom sheets.
Dense operational controls retain generous touch targets and direct labels.
The four independent product sides are the signature interaction, projected onto a true 3D garment when a product model exists and preserved as a four-view fallback otherwise.

rules.name: The Cyan Means Something Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks an action, focus, selection, or printable boundary; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Product Owns the Quiet Rule
rules.body: Keep the garment and blank-product imagery on white or cool near-white surfaces so artwork and product color remain truthful.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for display and decisive headings; use Inter for controls, fields, metadata, and explanatory copy.

rules.name: The Working-Layer Rule
rules.body: Use elevation only when one operational surface physically overlaps another; ordinary cards and fields remain border-led.

rules.name: The Reserved Pill Rule
rules.body: Use full rounding for actions, selectors, and compact status—not for structural panels or product media.

rules.name: The Product-Isolation Preview Rule
rules.body: Resolve the viewer from the active product ID and configuration only. In Auto mode, use a valid product-level model first and fall back to that same product's complete four-view mockups on absence or load failure. Never reuse another product's model, imagery, artwork state, or cache key.

rules.name: The Frame-Before-Artwork Rule
rules.body: Start each side from its admin-configured frame, let the customer place and size that frame in Image Step 1, then auto-fit uploaded artwork inside the chosen frame in Step 2.

dos: Do keep the garment or blank-product image as the largest and quietest element in its context.
Do reserve cyan for meaningful action and state, including focus and the print boundary.
Do preserve all four product sides as equal, persistent states across viewport sizes.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px and pair primary tool icons with visible labels when space allows.
Do use borders for resting structure and shadows only for overlapping working layers.
Do project every available side preview onto the configured 3D garment and preserve garment color while the model rotates.
Do keep the four-view preview fully usable for products without a model URL.
Do preserve a separate customer placement frame for front, back, right, and left.
Do require Done resizing before upload, then auto-fit and center artwork inside the chosen frame while preserving its aspect ratio.
donts: Don't turn the editor into a grid of freestanding dashboard cards; its shell, rails, stage, and inspectors are persistent spatial regions.
Don't use decorative gradients, hard offset shadows, or ornamental color on the product stage.
Don't use cyan as a general fill when no action, selection, focus, or print meaning is present.
Don't make product media or structural panels pill-shaped.
Don't let navigation, tool panels, or decoration outrank the garment, print area, side state, or live order action.
Don't require a GLB to inspect a design or present the four-view fallback as if it were continuous 3D geometry.
Don't treat the admin frame as immutable or allow upload while the active side's frame is still being resized.
